en: The image consists of two sides of a vintage postcard. The front side shows a monochrome photograph featuring a prominent church with a tall spire and clock, accompanied by another ornate building and well-manicured grounds. The buildings are labeled 'Kyrkan och Flickskolan' (the church and the girls' school) and attributed to the photographer Rob. Sahlin. Handwritten text at the top wishes a happy transition into 1906. The back side is addressed to 'Fröken Anna Svensson, Trädgårdsgatan, Jönköping', with Swedish postage and address formatting typical of early 20th century Sweden.
